title: Contract Pricing Note: Stock Value Share on VendPoint Substitute Settling Pars
content:
The contract unit price of a Corbett-placed substitute, as the customer's Contract Pricing Agreement records it, sets a stock value share on the substitute's settling par on a VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machine.

**Rule.** The stock value share follows the contract unit price on the substitute's contract price line written as a Corbett-approved substitute carrying the highest change reference: at or above the high value price the share is the high-value share, at or above the mid value price but below the high one the share is the mid-value share, and below it, or for an item with no such line, the share is one.

**Figures.** The high value price is 25 USD and the high-value share 0.8; the mid value price is 5 USD and the mid-value share 0.9.

### Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical prices)

| Contract unit price on the substitute's line | Share |
|---|---|
| 25.0000 USD | 0.8 |
| 24.9999 USD | 0.9 |
| 5.0000 USD | 0.9 |
| 4.9999 USD | 1 |
| no such line for the item | 1 |
